title: Beta-binomial with α = β = 1 and n = 2
caption: With a uniform prior on p, the number of successes in 2 trials is equally likely to be 0, 1 or 2: each has probability 1/3, mean 1.
alt: Bar chart with three equal bars at X = 0, 1, 2, each one third.
description: Averaging the binomial probabilities over a uniform p gives P(X = k) = 1/(n + 1) for every k.
With n = 2, each of 0, 1, 2 has probability 1/3.
